parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

Get the cluster ID by calling [ListClusters](~~87116~~).

parameters.name: JobIds
parameters.description:
A list of Serverless job IDs or subtask IDs (for array jobs).

> - For array jobs, specify only the subtask ID. The subtask ID format is \<array job ID>\_\<subtask index>. For example, 10\_3 refers to the subtask with index 3 in the array job with ID 10.
>
> - The list supports only one element.
